# Qt Declarative 6.11.1 upstream file-level test inventory

Generated from the upstream `v6.11.1` tree at commit `a02bed441965ee1f18f856352c7d5ee5ba35d795` on 2026-09-10.
This is an evidence inventory, not a claim that every file is an independent executable test case. The review N is the exact `tests/auto/` file count: **10372**. The recipe now enables the complete CMake test graph and runs the generated CTest registry without a target filter; current results come from the same CI log.

Accounting: **the inventory records source scope and historical gate evidence; current registered, passed, failed and skipped totals are recorded by the full-run CI log.** Each path below has one first-applicable build or runtime gate.

## Gate legend

- `R-QUICK`: Qt Quick scene graph/animation/RHI or GPU required
- `R-QMLTEST`: Qt Quick Test runner, QPA/display/input/event loop and QML data required
- `R-QML-DEBUG`: QML debug service, process and debugger IPC required
- `R-QUICKCONTROLS`: Quick Templates/styles/platform GUI/input services required
- `R-QUICKVECTOR`: Qt Quick plus Qt Svg dependency required
- `R-BIC`: ABI/compiler baseline fixture, not a standalone runtime test
- `R-QMLNETWORK`: OS network/SSL backend and service required
- `R-TOOLSUPPORT`: installed qtdeclarative QML testdata/import path required; build-tree fatal reproduced
- `R-QUICK`: QQuickWindow/render/QPA/window/input/RHI/OpenGL backend required
- `R-WASM`: Emscripten/browser/HTML/Selenium harness required
- `R-CORE`: device paths/settings/system-service state required
- `R-QUICKWIDGETS`: QtQuickWidgets/Qt Widgets GUI runtime required
- `R-QUICKTEST`: Quick Test runner/process/QPA/window/input behavior required
- `R-QML-TOOLING`: host tool/process, installed QML modules, plugin/IPC or generated-code environment required
- `R-QUICKDIALOGS`: native dialog backend/window service/user interaction required
- `R-QUICKSHAPES`: Qt Quick Shapes graphics/RHI/window backend required
- `R-QMLLS`: private QmlLS libraries, host subprocess and JSON-RPC/IPC required
- `R-CMAKE`: Qt BuildInternals/host CMake/generated-project harness not part of package CI
- `R-QMLTEST-BLACKLIST`: GUI/window/image/animation fixture and qmltestrunner required
- `R-COIN`: CI orchestration metadata, no standalone native CTest binary
- `R-QMLDOM`: private Qt QmlDom target; cross-build/package contract does not expose it
- `R-GUI`: GUI example launcher requires window backend and interaction
- `R-QML-OPTIONAL`: private/SQL/worker/XML/network/compiler feature or extra Qt target required
- `R-QML-CORE`: additional QML engine/language family needs generated testdata/private plugin/installed import tree
- `R-ANDROID`: Android-only Gradle/JNI/Activity integration
